headline: Vardhman Acrylics submits September demat report to exchange
hook: Routine compliance filing from Vardhman Acrylics
summary: Vardhman Acrylics Limited has submitted its mandatory monthly demat report for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing confirming the status of dematerialized shares. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update carries no immediate financial or stock-moving impact.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on your portfolio.
